title: v1.34.0 was tagged but never published to npm; superseded by v1.35.0 while its npm-publish deployment waited for environment approval
observation: Release run 34846213977 for tag v1.34.0 (commit 2f5075c) passed validate and both platform-matrix-safety jobs, then its publish job entered the npm-publish environment review at 13:07 UTC with zero steps executed. A parallel session merged #231 and the 1.35.0 release PR #232 and tagged v1.35.0 at 14:36 UTC; the 1.34.0 deployment ended as failure at 14:57 UTC. npm latest moves 1.33.0 → 1.35.0; 1.34.0 never existed on the registry. Every 1.34.0 change ships in 1.35.0. Practical rule: a tag push only starts a review; until the human approves the npm-publish deployment, the next release commit supersedes it, and the CHANGELOG entry needs the 'superseded before npm publication' note (precedent 1.32.6).
